findings.boundary: This is a structural policy/configuration parity gap, not a claim that the shipped demo is exploitable by default. If a route is disabled in ToolRouter, a direct task branch must independently recheck the same gate or route through a shared preflight before spawn.
findings.evidence: TaskDemo.call_tool checks slow_sum+client task capability and directly parses args then TaskManager.spawn before the fallback ToolRouter.call path. ToolRouter.call independently enforces its disabled-route set.

findings.boundary: Correlation IDs and caller-supplied _meta can transport identity but are not documented durable idempotency or authorization authority.
findings.evidence: RequestContext exposes JSON-RPC RequestId and arbitrary meta; CallToolRequestParams exposes request_state.

findings.boundary: Not stock rmcp behavior. Requires custom persistent server/store; resident external runtime remains an unresolved strict Phase-1 child.
findings.evidence: 13/13 local stdlib model fixtures pass: side-effect-free preflight, current-policy recheck, method/tool/args/principal/expiry integrity binding, atomic create-or-get, lost-response same-handle recovery, and negative mismatch/tamper/revocation cases.

findings.boundary: Exact v1.44.1 does not expose a dedicated public/supported 'serialize validated overrides + one snapshot + silent in-memory sync' recovery primitive. R7 should add a dedicated internal helper rather than perform recovery through public __setattr__.
findings.evidence: ConversationState public field writes autosave immediately or mark dirty inside its context; __exit__ flushes dirty state. LocalConversation default callback append_event advances HEAD then sets last_user_message_id, so both bookkeeping mutations can be deferred until context exit after the event file append. _save_base_state serializes self and writes under the configured write guard.

findings.boundary: FileStore.write interface itself does not promise atomic replacement, so the R7 one-snapshot guarantee cannot be generalized to arbitrary custom FileStore backends without an explicit atomic-write contract/capability. atomic_write_text does not fsync the parent directory after replace, so do not upgrade this to full power-loss durability evidence.
findings.evidence: LocalFileStore.write(str) uses atomic_write_text, which writes a temp file, flushes+fsyncs the file, then os.replace()s it. ConversationState.create selects LocalFileStore when persistence_dir is supplied and no custom FileStore is injected.
